notes: Cover panel re-shoot of agomoni-02-hibiscus: standing, full length, headroom for the tall crop.
prompt: Editorial fashion photograph for an Indian handloom label's festive lookbook. Tall vertical 9:16 frame.
GARMENT (a real product; match the reference photos exactly, including colours, borders and motifs):

- Saree: the deep maroon mul saree from the first three references, foil-printed with large gold hibiscus flowers clustered along the pallu and small scattered gold dots on the body, edged with a thin gold gota border. Soft, slightly lustrous drape.
- Blouse: the plain antique-gold sleeveless cotton blouse from the last two references, high rounded neckline.
- Draped with the pallu over the left shoulder and gathered across the front so the gold hibiscus flowers are prominent across her chest and arm.

MUSE: a Bengali woman in her mid-forties, dusky skin, a few silver strands in her hair, worn in a low knot with a small red hibiscus; a broad sindoor line, a large round red bindi, gold jhumkas, shankha and pola bangles, a gold temple choker. Composed and devotional, eyes half-closed in prayer.

MOMENT AND PLACE: Sandhi puja night in a family puja dalan: she stands before the softly out-of-focus goddess, holding the brass five-wick lamp at chest height; rows of small diyas on the floor at her feet.
LIGHT: Lit only by flame: the lamp lights her face and the gold hibiscus print; deep maroon shadows around.
COVER FRAMING (this photograph becomes one tall, narrow panel of the lookbook's opening page, behind a large title):
- POSE: she is standing upright, full length, head to toe in frame; ignore any seated or kneeling pose mentioned above.
- HEADROOM: the top quarter of the frame is calm, empty background (sky, wall, foliage or soft darkness); her head sits about a quarter of the way down, never near the top edge.
- Subject centred horizontally and filling the middle third of the width, so a narrow vertical crop keeps all of her.
- Keep the background simple and softly out of focus; nothing busy behind her face.
- CAMERA: eye level, 50mm lens at f/2.8, gentle depth of field, medium-format look with fine grain.
